title: FillRequest
description: May the extension fill this field now? The page reports what it measured; the core decides.

frame.description: The address of the frame holding the field; equal to top when there is no frame.

field_visible.description: The field and every ancestor are visible, on screen and not covered by anything, whatever the coverer's opacity or pointer-events.

user_confirmed.description: The person already took a deliberate action for this fill.

decision.description: What decide returned for the item on this frame.
